description: This file defines HTTP endpoints for serving Facebook SDK scripts in an OrchardCore module, including caching and cache-busting mechanisms.

classes.name: GetSdkEndpoints
classes.description: Contains static methods to add Facebook SDK related endpoints to the application's routing.

classes.name: GetInitScriptEndpoint
classes.description: Provides an endpoint to serve the Facebook init JavaScript with cache busting.

classes.name: GetFetchScriptEndpoint
classes.description: Provides an endpoint to serve the Facebook SDK script with cache busting and culture-specific URL.

methods.name: AddSdkEndpoints
methods.description: Extension method to add Facebook SDK endpoints to the route builder.

methods.name: HashCacheBustingValues
methods.description: Generates a hash based on Facebook settings to invalidate cache when settings change.

methods.name: HandleRequestAsync
methods.description: Handles HTTP request for the init script, serving cached or freshly generated script.

methods.name: HashCacheBustingValues
methods.description: Generates a hash based on Facebook SDK JS URL to invalidate cache when SDK URL changes.

methods.name: HandleRequestAsync
methods.description: Handles HTTP request for the culture-specific SDK script, serving cached or generated script.
